sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 18 (#17 solution_covers_every_deliverable) and Internal Quality Checks row 18 (same wording, no extra annotation)
evidence: Walked instruction.md and all three /instructions notes line by line against solution/app. Every asked-for capability has an implementation: sign-in-only shell with no data before auth (index.html #signin; app.js boot() calls /api/me first; server requireUser on every /api route, transcript 401 page server.js:502); staff/client visibility and walls across list, thread, search, quotes, unread, mentions, link previews, transcripts and direct requests (server.js canSee/visibleMatter/visibleMessage 189-201, previewsFor 226-235, mentionedEmails 209-218, people endpoint 340-345, transcript 504-505, NOT_AVAILABLE 404s); partner add/lift wall UI + live removal (index.html #wall-form, server.js 479-490, app.js 2s polling startPolling 640-651 -> showUnavailable); timers off/1/7/30 shown beside title, partner-only, >= age deletion, shortening sweeps, off/lengthen never restores (server.js sweep 139-146, timer route 467-477, timerLabel 246; app.js #matter-timer); legal hold partner-only on any message, exempt from timer and author delete, released -> immediate sweep, 'On hold' badge separate from body text (server.js 452, 457-465); nested replies any depth in send order with short quote and deleted-parent placeholder, same-matter parent enforced (threadFor 253-279, shapeMessage quote 287, POST 405-411); edits with 'edited', staff-only earlier versions, stale-version 409 keeping typed text, author delete with in-page confirm/'Keep it' (server.js 368-376, 427-455; app.js startEdit/askDelete/composer submit 474-493); safe *bold*, `code`, '> ' quote, http(s) links target=_blank on escaped text, raw text in quotes/snippets/versions/transcript (app.js inline/renderBody 27-55, textContent elsewhere, server esc 494); copyable message links with per-viewer preview / 'not available', link and search result open thread and highlight until something else opened (app.js copyLink 525-533, openMessageLink 583-591, focusMessage); @ mentions by first name case-insensitive, suggestions limited to people who can see the matter, picking inserts name, mentions list, edit-in/out and delete update (server.js recordMentions, PATCH 441, eraseMessage 153; app.js suggestMentions/pickMention, openMentions); per-user server-side unread counts excluding deleted, 'New messages' line, mark unread from any message (server.js 239-245, 346-360; app.js openMatter 186-195, markUnread 516-524); Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (app.js 411-422); idempotent client_key sends and seq ordering in thread/search/transcript (server.js 403-424, 387); live polling preserving composer, scroll and open version panels (applyMatter 225-239); 390px media query (styles.css 118-127); search case-insensitive literal includes() over current text only (382-391); transcript page with matter number, title, generated time, threaded oldest-first, author, time, edited, hold, versions for held edited messages, deleted placeholder, no controls (497-518); refusal text kept next to the action (messageErrors, composer/timer/wall errors). Runtime contract: Node 22 server.js resolving files via __dirname, 0.0.0.0:3000, DB_PATH default app.db next to server.js, health 200 before DB (42), seed imported once via settings 'seeded' flag, fixed clock from seed, UTC display, no app.db or symlinks shipped (find -type l empty), seed copied into /app (app/seed/seed_data.json, sha256 b256f85e... identical to environment/assets). Runtime corroboration: all frozen solution file hashes match raw-evidence-index matching_source_files, and golden-run.log (sha256 58d77dc1...) records PASS for gate_constraints, all 16 functional checks, persistence before/after a real restart, and the 6 polish checks, including @-suggestion pick (functional.cjs 228-240). This is scripted golden evidence only, not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score; render/visual were not run, which bears on other rows, not on reference coverage. Adversarial angle: a weaker reference missing e.g. the @ suggestion picker or mark-unread would fail this row; none found. A conforming alternative (different routes, seed path at /app/seed_data.json) is not penalised by this row. Minor note only: brief says 'Copy /assets/seed_data.json into /app'; golden places it at /app/seed/seed_data.json (inside /app, byte-identical) with fallbacks to /app/seed_data.json and /assets; transcript renders raw text rather than *bold* formatting, which the brief permits as a plain reading page.
